# SYNESIS_E129 — Warning

## Description

Derived label "Label" of `concept_a` matches `example`.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the preferred label of `concept_a`, derived from the name
  ("Label"), matches a label of `example`. Declare a
  LABEL PREFERRED for one of the two.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **DerivedLabelConflict**: `block`, `concept`, `label`, `other`
